summary: The note is a short encyclopedic entry on the Goodrich Corporation, formerly the B.F. Goodrich Company, an American aerospace manufacturer headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. It traces the company's founding in Akron, Ohio in 1870 by Dr. Benjamin Franklin Goodrich and its successive name changes. The note is brief and covers only naming history and origins.
one_line: Goodrich Corporation, a former Charlotte-based American aerospace manufacturer, traces its origins to 1870 Akron and its name changes.
key_facts: The Goodrich Corporation was an American aerospace manufacturing company based in Charlotte, North Carolina.
The Goodrich Corporation was formerly known as the B.F. Goodrich Company.
The company was founded in Akron, Ohio in 1870.
The company was founded as Goodrich, Tew & Co.
The company was founded by Dr. Benjamin Franklin Goodrich.
The company name was changed to the B.F. Goodrich Company in 1880.
The company name was changed to BFGoodrich in the 1980s.
The company name was changed to Goodrich Corporation in 2001.
